appName: I Am Street Cat Simulator Runner
displayName: I Am Street Cat Simulator Runner
display_name: I Am Street Cat Simulator Runner
display_long_description:
Live the life of a street cat in a thrilling endless runner adventure! 🐱
Run through bustling alleys, jump over obstacles, and escape from chasing dogs while exploring the city streets. Meet mischievous raccoons along the way — some are friends, some add chaos!
Be a street cat: Climb fences, leap over trash cans, and explore rooftops.
Raccoon mischief: Watch out for playful raccoons, steal treats, or team up with them.
Survive dog chases: Outsmart city dogs that try to catch you at every turn.
Endless runner gameplay: Keep running, collect items, and achieve high scores.
Immersive VR experience: Feel like you’re truly living as a street cat in a dynamic city environment.
Whether you’re a cat lover, a fan of action-packed endless runners, or just want to experience life on the streets from a feline perspective, I Am Street Cat Simulator Runner brings hours of fun, adventure, and excitement!
Key Features:
Endless city streets to explore
Interactive raccoons and dogs
Dynamic obstacles and challenges
VR-ready immersive gameplay
Collect treats, power-ups, and bonuses
Run, jump, and survive as the ultimate street cat — can you master the streets and avoid the dogs while making friends with raccoons?
